llm.notes: Downloaded automatically by the .NET launcher with bezzad/Downloader when missing. The launcher starts the redistributed llama-server directly on port 8080 and passes this GGUF with -m.

asr.notes: Downloaded automatically by the .NET launcher with bezzad/Downloader when missing. Native whisper.cpp model; no Python or CTranslate2 runtime is required.

tts.notes: Both native qwentts.cpp GGUFs are downloaded automatically by the .NET launcher with bezzad/Downloader when missing. tts-server.exe listens on http://127.0.0.1:8101; the .NET application calls it directly.

vision.notes: Downloaded automatically when missing. The launcher appends --mmproj when this file exists; otherwise screen vision is disabled for that launch and normal chat still works.
